test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) INN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6886a0beadb64d3f13cca0340066077b773bc73236a9b9a59044270d3f7e3d21.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3036e78f68cb513f6bab56d77cebd989dc5d0aaefc14155ddd82166eed1edc22.png] 

Option 2) NRS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dea2cf15a56d3fc86eac81b0c09c9e7a8cda7a6d6e3bdcba561b57aa86a9f5f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74882a48b09f0c796821e9c472dc8ecdd9773b442a8ce630f4367f597aa139ce.png] 

Option 3) UYZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f38fbdc7a64b5d2a8ee61f02ee040ac7484584a1ec9d2d51f45f5d2f66c68cbc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbb944c6cb3781f2a21046f9bd1950d529f6cb338e31494d5dc77546ae9ab104.png] 

Option 4) JNO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/667e945ff2295f5edacf45013e4c03dae0e9a6756ae04ec32da62cc2cd09ac99.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d2b6c959b566dbc8f2d1afa6bbaf13358dc5ca514aac964f0209578e423edb1.png] 

Here, '**INN**' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
